# Tool reference

`gvm-mcp` exposes 194 tools in 25 toolsets; 99 of them
are read-only. Tool and parameter names follow gvmd's own vocabulary, so
what you know from the web interface applies here. Choose toolsets with
`--toolsets` and drop every mutating tool with `--read-only` (see
[Toolsets](../../toolsets.md)).

| Toolset | Scope | Tools | Read-only | Default |
| --- | --- | ---: | ---: | --- |
| [system](system.md) | Connectivity, health, version and timezone information | 3 | 3 | yes |
| [targets](targets.md) | Scan targets (hosts, port lists), OCI image and web application targets | 18 | 6 | yes |
| [tasks](tasks.md) | Scan tasks and their lifecycle (start/stop/resume/clone) | 9 | 2 | yes |
| [scan-configs](scan-configs.md) | Scan configurations, NVT/family selection, preferences and generic configs | 16 | 8 | yes |
| [scanners](scanners.md) | Scanner instances | 2 | 2 | yes |
| [schedules](schedules.md) | Scan schedules | 5 | 2 | yes |
| [credentials](credentials.md) | Authenticated-scan credentials and credential stores | 9 | 4 | yes |
| [alerts](alerts.md) | Alerts and notifications | 5 | 2 | yes |
| [port-lists](port-lists.md) | Port lists | 5 | 2 | yes |
| [results](results.md) | Individual scan results | 2 | 2 | yes |
| [reports](reports.md) | Scan reports, drill-down pages, imports and exports | 18 | 15 | yes |
| [assets](assets.md) | Host, operating-system and generic assets | 13 | 6 | yes |
| [tls-certificates](tls-certificates.md) | TLS certificates discovered by scans | 2 | 2 | yes |
| [report-formats](report-formats.md) | Report formats | 2 | 2 | yes |
| [filters](filters.md) | Saved filters | 6 | 2 | yes |
| [tags](tags.md) | Tags on resources | 6 | 2 | yes |
| [notes](notes.md) | Notes on results | 5 | 2 | yes |
| [overrides](overrides.md) | Severity overrides | 5 | 2 | yes |
| [nvts](nvts.md) | NVTs and NVT families | 3 | 3 | yes |
| [secinfo](secinfo.md) | CVE, CPE, CERT-Bund and DFN-CERT catalogs | 8 | 8 | yes |
| [vulnerabilities](vulnerabilities.md) | Vulnerability listing | 1 | 1 | yes |
| [feeds](feeds.md) | Feed status | 1 | 1 | yes |
| [compliance](compliance.md) | Compliance audits and policies | 13 | 4 | yes |
| [agents](agents.md) | Sensor agents and agent groups | 14 | 6 | yes |
| [identity](identity.md) | Users, groups, roles, permissions (opt-in) | 23 | 10 | opt-in |
